BiblicalUsage: tsᵉphîyâh stands behind the English phrase watchfulness. In Lamentations 4:17, in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that watching for help that never comes is the ache of Lamentations, and I have felt that waiting myself.
